system.description:
A collection of tools and supplies for patching up injuries, specialized to help patch up soldiers injured during combat. The main tool is a wand-like device which uses nanotech to seal wounds and stimulate natural healing processes, along with a number of modular attachments that help dealing with specific types of combat injury, and which are capable of stimulating adrenaline production to get a wounded soldier back on their feet fast.

A Combat Medkit allows a character to treat Injuries a character has suffered, as well as providing the means to provide longer-term care to heal treated injuries. Further, when used to treat an Injury, the user may spend 1 Momentum to immediately wake a defeated character, allowing them to act once more. A Combat Medkit can treat Injuries with a damage rating of up to 6. Combat Medkits are powered and recharge after a Break rest.
